title: I’m starting a new AI-assisted side-scroller called Codename Retro
author: HappyClamOfficial
selftext:
This project is still in very early development. The current thumbnail and title are not final.

I’m using AI as part of the development process, including for visual concept work and exploring ideas for characters, enemies, bosses, and stages. The current Blackbomber artwork is AI-assisted concept art rather than a gameplay screenshot.

The game is planned to be a side-scrolling action game with many stages and bosses. I’m also letting the community give me ideas I can put into the game.

Do you have any ideas for the game? If you give any idea, there is a possibility it may go into the game. [https://happyclam.itch.io/codename-retro](https://happyclam.itch.io/codename-retro)
